title: MXene–AuPtPdCu nanoalloy-based aptameric immunosensor for differential pulse voltammetric quantification of colorectal cancer exosomes

Ti3C2Tx MXene–AuPtPdCu nanoalloy-based aptameric electrochemical immunosensor enables ultrasensitive detection of colorectal cancer-derived exosomes via CD63 recognition and DPV signal suppression, offering a promising liquid-biopsy platform.
